pulse.text: **Quiet three hours** — nothing shipped, and Claude Opus 5 still holds #1 with Anthropic priced at **92%** to own the best model at the end of August. The one real move is Google cooling: Polymarket's next-Gemini-Pro market slid to **58% by Aug 31 from 61%**, a second straight drop, with the Aug 21 leg at 23% and Aug 14 at just 10% — the month's probability mass is now crammed into its final ten days. Backfilled this sweep: **FLUX 3 Video went generally available Aug 4**, Black Forest Labs' 20-second HD model that generates its audio natively in the same pass and that BFL's own all-vs-all Elo puts first in text-to-video at 1135. Elsewhere the drift is small — the Anthropic-IPO-first market eased again to **85% from 86%**, Astra's Sep 15 leg firmed to 53% from 51% after OpenAI said it cannot rule out critical cyber capabilities, and **Grok 4.6 still does not exist** in xAI's own docs, whose model list and release notes top out at grok-4.5. Watch Alibaba next: Qwen says the Qwen3.8-Max weights plus a Qwen3.8-27B land the week of Aug 10, the first Max-class open-weight drop, with the license still undisclosed.
